mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months (as measured by FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the UNRATE rise, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months signals an economic contraction that prompts monetary easing, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST does not produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized rate > 3.5%), the Federal Reserve's tightening policy typically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of high inflation periods, or the signal's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 units in the prior 3 months signals a weakening real estate market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1000, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months signals robust consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in strong RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment growth (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals an economic slowdown that triggers monetary easing, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: economic slowdown with labor market weakness
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and PAYEMS does not produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% annually), the Federal Reserve's tightening policy typically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the signal's Rank IC is negative.
